goal: Create a Korean owner-facing approval gate document so BK/Human Creative Owner can approve, redirect, or reject Phase 2 platformer greybox implementation readiness.
forbidden_changes: final art, generated production assets, imported sprites, brand style, concept art, or style bible decisions
enemy, item, scoring, camera polish, web export, double jump, wall jump, or dash decisions
Working, Canonical, or Policy Learning Card promotion

verify.name: Owner review remains pending and owner-facing
verify.description: Confirm the owner review is Korean, summarizes game brief/research/art manifest, includes approve/redirect/reject options, records Decision as pending, and does not authorize implementation without BK approval.

verify.name: Only authorized Phase 2D artifacts changed
verify.command: bash -lc 'extra=$(git status --short --untracked-files=all | sed "s/^...//" | grep -Ev "^(PHASE2_PLATFORMER_GREYBOX_PLAN.md|context/game_brief.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-008.json|runs/RUN-20260528-005.json|research_notes/RN-2026W22-002-platformer-greybox-reference.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-009.json|runs/RUN-20260528-006.json|art_notes/AN-2026W22-002-platformer-greybox-readability.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-010.json|runs/RUN-20260528-007.json|owner_reviews/OR-2026W22-002-platformer-greybox-KR.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-011.json|runs/RUN-20260528-008.json)$" || true); test -z "$extra"'

human_decision_reason: BK/Human Creative Owner must approve, redirect, or reject the Phase 2 implementation boundary before Implementation Agent may mutate Godot files.
acceptance_criteria: The Work Package authorizes only the owner review gate document, its Work Package record, and its Run record.
The owner review document is Korean and complete enough for BK to judge without relying on English-only workflow text.
The owner review summarizes the game brief, research note, Art/readability manifest, approval scope, excluded scope, decision options, and implementation authorization boundary.
The owner review records Decision as pending and does not claim BK approval.
No Godot, script, schema, agent profile, context, research note, art note, QA review, or Learning Card files are changed by this slice.
notes: This Work Package creates the Phase 2D owner approval gate. It does not itself approve implementation.
